sources.title: Qwen3.8 Fine-tuning Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Unsloth utilizes Flash Linear Attention kernels for efficient Qwen3.8 training Use Qwen3.8-27B-unsloth-bnb-4bit for 4-bit QLoRA, then export to NVFP4, FP8, GGUF etc. If you want to preserve reasoning ability, mix reasoning-style examples with direct answers and keep at least 75% reasoning data.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next features a 125B -parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B parameters activated per token. Compared with Qwen3.7-Plus, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next substantially reduces both training and inference cost — training takes only about 1/9 as much, yet it delivers superior capabilities in coding and office tasks.
